scenario_description:
Objective: Improve this week’s studio walk-through materials with a short community process feature if a suitable editorial slot opens.
Emerging Need: A possible sidebar remains speculative until the theme, submission route, and image permission line up inside a brief publication window.
Decision Context: Stored studio wording notes supply the approved reclaim-clay description and photo-credit rule; live calendar, email, and message updates determine when those notes become usable.
Consequence: Ignoring the chance leaves the walk-through packet ordinary, with no failed duty, but after editorial lock the optional feature cannot appear in this packet.

parameter.title: Mesa Clay Trail studio walk-through
parameter.description: Volunteer photographer will preview the detached studio and courtyard approach for the March packet; packet proceeds with the standard listing if no sidebar material is available.

parameter.subject: March packet sidebar decision still pending
parameter.body: The March packet may have one small process-note sidebar if the sponsor page settles. Please do not send material yet; there is no mailbox or theme until the editorial desk confirms whether the slot exists.

parameter.content: I found the shelf-cleanout phone shot from last month. If a community feature needs a process image, you can use it with the credit line “Photo: Jules Marin”; it shows the reclaim bucket and no address labels.

parameter.subject: Process-note sidebar open until 2:30 today
parameter.body: The sponsor page is set, leaving one optional process-note sidebar for Friday's packet. Submissions received by 2:30 PM today will be considered at features@mesaclaytrail.example with subject line “Process note - March packet.” Theme: reclaimed clay and dust-conscious studio routines. Limit is 50 words; one phone photo may be included.

parameter.subject: March packet process sidebar is locked
parameter.body: The 2:30 PM editorial lock has passed, and the process-note sidebar has been filled for Friday's packet. Late material will not be added to this packet.
